title: Narrow primary-text review of Guralnick--Magaard Theorem1
bibliographic: Robert Guralnick and Kay Magaard, On the minimal degree of a primitive permutation group, Journal of Algebra207(1998),127-145, DOI10.1006/jabr.1998.7451
portions_read: Original-paper introduction printed128 and Theorem1 printed128-129 through Corollary1 printed130; web-extracted author-uploaded paper text.
used_paraphrase: In the nonalternating binary affine/classical cases, an element fixing at least half the permutation points is a transvection, hence an involution; includes the triality equivalent action. Product cases have already been removed by PF120.
